case_variable: continuous side of authored island envelope during ego passage
fixed_context: same ring road and island geometry bytes, actor blueprint, weather, frame times, speed and lane for each paired candidate

requested_cases.reference: counterclockwise exterior passage with island requested on ego left
requested_cases.contrast: clockwise exterior passage with island requested on ego right

fallback_routing_targets.fallback1: measured camera or island occlusion requests slower passage
fallback_routing_targets.fallback2: measured lane-center deviation requests wider outer lane
fallback_routing_targets.fallback3: measured physical-island or traffic-control uncertainty requests stop before passage

required_original_measurements: Native map and physical island readback with body-level island boundary
240 synchronized ego transforms, velocities and body vertices
continuous body-to-island side and clearance at every occupied frame
camera-frame joins and review of island and traffic controls
source-hashed comparison of actual reference and contrast traversals
historical_membership_limit: Three accepted membership records are context only; no source-hashed equivalence receipt is available and no original is replayed
legal_limit: Authored ring geometry and requested headings do not prove a physical rotary island, continuous right-of-island passage, legal disposition or accepted original evidence
